settings.accounts.continue_detail: Local Codex switches the login for open tabs sharing ~/.codex. Running Agents restart and sleeping tabs return to sleep. Claude continues only the selected conversation using its existing handoff flow.
settings.accounts.continue_warning: Running tools are interrupted. Hosted connectors such as Slack need a connection on the selected account.
settings.accounts.default_save_failed: Could not save the default account: {error}
settings.accounts.editor_hint: Local Codex profiles share ~/.codex. Save the current login, or Sign in to save another account. Hosted connectors such as Slack must be connected on each account. Claude and remote profiles use their own directories.
settings.accounts.footer: Editing or removing a profile affects future launches. Existing sessions retain their account. Removing a profile leaves the provider’s files and credentials intact.
settings.accounts.intro: Sign in to each Claude Code or Codex account once, then switch in one click, here or from the bottom-left menu. Open tabs restart on the new login and pick up their conversations; settings, MCP setup and history stay shared. Running tools are interrupted, and hosted connections may need authorization on the selected account.
settings.accounts.is_default: ✓ Default for this Agent on this host
settings.accounts.name: Name
settings.accounts.name_required: Enter a name for this profile before saving it.
settings.accounts.no_other_account: No other account is set up for this Agent on this machine. Add a profile and sign in, then return here.
settings.accounts.not_checked: Not checked yet: limits show once this account is used again.
settings.accounts.other_detail: Remote hosts, and older profiles that keep a directory of their own. Choose them when launching an agent.
settings.accounts.selected_host: Selected: {host}. The directory is on this machine.
settings.accounts.switched_deferred: {count} open tab(s) could not be identified and keep the previous login until restarted.
settings.accounts.switched_notice: Switched {switched} conversations; {unchanged} separate-home tabs unchanged. This account is now the default. Local MCP configuration is unchanged. Hosted connectors such as Slack require a connection on the selected account.
settings.accounts.title: Accounts
settings.accounts.use_default: Use by default for this Agent on this host
settings.usage.about_pricing: Uses Diri’s bundled model rates for Claude and Codex. Cursor costs come from billed dashboard events. Unpriced Claude/Codex usage is excluded from cost. Cache read savings compare cached reads with uncached input rates; cache write premiums are excluded.
settings.usage.about_sources: Includes local and remote Claude Code and Codex transcripts, including sessions outside Diri, plus billed Cursor usage on this Mac. Remote machines refresh every 5 minutes over SSH; unavailable machines keep their last saved totals.
settings.usage.activity_remote_daily: Remote machines report daily totals on their UTC date, so hours and the weekly rhythm are available for this Mac only.
settings.usage.activity_remote_hourly: Remote machines report daily totals: they add tokens and cost on their UTC date, not active hours.
settings.usage.empty_detail: Available Claude Code and Codex transcripts appear automatically, alongside signed-in Cursor usage on this Mac.
settings.usage.empty_hint: Try a longer date range to see earlier activity.
settings.usage.empty_title: Your usage starts with a conversation
settings.usage.hero_detail: Claude and Codex at model rates. Cursor is billed usage.
settings.usage.loading_detail: Preparing costs and token history from local Claude Code and Codex transcripts, plus billed Cursor usage when signed in.
settings.usage.remote_unavailable: Usage unavailable · retries every 5 minutes; check the connection in Remote settings
settings.usage.rhythm_caption: When you work · active hours by weekday and local hour
settings.usage.subtitle_cost: Estimated API cost · compared with the previous period of the same length.
settings.usage.subtitle_tokens: Processed tokens · compared with the previous period of the same length.
settings.usage.title: Usage
settings.worktrees.empty_detail: Add a local project to Diri, then refresh to review its linked worktrees.
settings.worktrees.empty_error_detail: Refresh to retry. Your worktrees have not been changed.
settings.worktrees.empty_scanning_detail: Worktrees appear as they are found. PR and status checks follow.
settings.worktrees.footer: Age is checkout age, not last use. PRs use GitHub CLI access. Disk sizes are measured only on request, for cleanup candidates.
settings.worktrees.remove_detail: Deletes this checkout and ignored files, including build output. Keeps the Git branch.
settings.worktrees.subtitle: Local projects · branches and commits are kept after cleanup
settings.worktrees.title: Worktrees
settings.worktrees.update_engine: Update the engine to inspect cleanup safety
